independence_route: Fresh contexts and separately authored proof/code. I1 only if reached; same-model instance agreement alone is not external verification.
replay_route: Fresh relocated public-only replay using documented standard scientific dependencies; R2 only if reached.
prediction_policy: Before every attempt seal predictions and code/input hashes, including extra recovered sources. Keep every prior version/failure.
resource_policy: Untimed bounded local CR2, one process per track, existing shared arithmetic budget. No Duck or remote compute.
lead_policy: No scientific steering or scratch reading during verifier work; full review and fresh replay afterward.
external_publication: Separate upload authorization applies only to its named payload; no automatic export from preparation.
